aux_uncertainty_id.description: Suffix added to variable_id that indicates a statistical uncertainty quantity
aux_uncertainty_id.notes: Can be used to query if uncertainty data is available or associated

activity_id.notes: Renamed from 'project_id' in ODS 1.0. Renamed to be more generic, since not all activities are projects

comment.description: Miscellaneous information about the data or methods used to produce it
comment.notes: CF Conventions global attribute; No change from original obs4MIPs or CMIP5

contact.description: Name and contact information (e.g., email, address, phone number) of person who should be contacted for more information about the data

Conventions.description: Standards convention version that the data adheres to
Conventions.notes: CF Conventions global attribute; Now changed from ODS 1.0 to a list of conventions separated by single spaces

creation_date.description: The ISO 8601 UTC date and time in which the prepared data file was created
creation_date.notes: No change from original obs4MIPs specs (automatically generated with CMOR3); e.g., YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

dataset_contributor.description: The name of the individual who obtained the original data and made it obs4MIPs compliant
dataset_contributor.notes: Helps make the process of preparing obs4MIPs compliant data fully traceable

data_specs_version.description: Version identifier or GitHub 'tag' of the obs4MIPs CVs GitHub repository referenced while preparing the dataset

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) of the dataset before preparation for obs4MIPs
doi.notes: DOI should point to the source of the prepared dataset

external_variables.description: A space-separated list of variables associated with attributes in the file but which are not present in the file. These variables are to be found in other files (called 'external files')
external_variables.notes: CF Conventions global attribute; one example of an external variable is 'cell measures', which are stored as variables in separate files and are named like 'areacella', 'areacello', 'volcella', or 'volcello' according to CMIP6; instead of having cell measures in separate files, we recommend including them directly as grid bounds associated with latitude, longitude, or depth

frequency.description: How often the variable is sampled or recorded

grid.description: A description of the horizontal grid, resolution, and re-gridding procedure if applicable
grid.notes: In the case of in situ observations, this should be set to 'site' or 'site-collection'

grid_label.description: A grid-related identifier code used in the dataset's filename; used to distinguish when the variable is reported on its native grid, when it's been re-gridded, or when it is provided on several different grids; there should be one dataset file per grid
grid_label.notes: In the case of in situ observations, this should be set to 'site-' + site_id or 'site-collection'

has_aux_unc.description: A boolean flag used to indicate whether there is uncertainty data associated with a variable

history.description: A character string containing an audit trail for modifications to the original data.  Each modification is typically preceded by a timestamp

institution.description: Description of the institution(s) responsible for the dataset, including the curator role if data is no longer managed by the original individual or entity; can also be used to identify the institution(s) of a '3rd party' contributor

institution_id.description: A unique identifier for the institution(s) responsible for the dataset

license.description: A description of the usage license associated with the prepared dataset
license.notes: Ensures that anyone using the file has access to the terms of use

nominal_resolution.description: Approximate horizontal resolution of the prepared dataset

processing_code_location.description: Direct link to the code used to prepare the dataset
processing_code_location.notes: Ensures transparency in the preparation of ODS-compliant data by pointing to the processing code and supporting materials

product.description: Where the measurements in the prepared dataset originate from

realm.description: The Earth system component, physical domain or process category, to which a variable primarily pertains

references.description: A list of published or web-based references that describe the data or the methods used to produce it

region.description: The dataset's representative geographic region that has complex boundaries which cannot practically be specified using longitude and latitude boundary coordinates
region.notes: Derived from CF Conventions Geographic Regions standardized names: https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-standard-names/docs/standardized-region-names.html

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the in-situ measurement location of the individual site or 'site-collection' if multiple sites

site_location.description: A description for the in-situ measurement location of the individual site or 'site-collection' if multiple sites

source.description: A description of the dataset or an expansion of the acronyms or abbreviations used in the source_id

source_id.description: Unique identifier of the dataset in the form of an acronym, abbreviation, or author(s) with the version appended to the end of the identifier
source_id.notes: Spaces and periods are forbidden characters and should be replaced with hyphens; used when contructing the dataset filename

source_data_notes.description: A description to highlight any technical details regarding how the data were retrieved, e.g., via a script or manual download

source_data_retrieval_date.description: The ISO 8601 UTC formatted date and time in which the dataset was retrieved from the original data source

source_data_url.description: The URL location where source data was retrieved, usually the curator of the data
source_data_url.notes: Helps to improve version control transparency

source_label.description: The same as source_id but without the version appended to the end
source_label.notes: This is used in faceted searches to get a truncated list of sources without all of the different versions listed

source_type.description: How the product was generated or derived from the observations

source_version_number.description: The number identifying the version of the source
source_version_number.notes: The same as the version number included in source_id but with special characters like '_' and '.' allowed; e.g., 'v1.0', '1.2', 'ver2.3.1', etc.

title.description: A general description of the observation product, which might, for example, include the name of the institution and/or model
title.notes: Used in programs like ncview as the title of the plot

tracking_id.notes: Automatically generated by CMOR or can be built using the UUID library

variable_id.description: Unique variable name preferrably aligned with the most recent CMIP generation
variable_id.notes: Updated to handle anomaly data for ODS 2.6; anomaly variables should be the most recent generation CMIP variable_id with the suffix 'anom' appended (e.g., for variable_id 'tas' the anomaly variable_id would be 'tasanom')

variant_info.description: Description of the '3rd party' dataset preparer and, if applicable, a description of the ensemble dataset variant

variant_label.description: The dataset preparer (either the institution_id or shorthand/acronym representing the '3rd party' preparer) and, if an observational 'ensemble', a concatenated '-' followed by a variant modifer
variant_label.notes: E.g., just 'PCMDI' if not an ensemble with variations; 'PCMDI-BE' for a default configuration; 'PCMDI-r1' for a specific processing method; 'PCMDI-r2' for a different processing method; etc.; Variant modifiers are defined in the CVs
